event_items.title: Jubilee Concert
event_items.description: A festive evening filled with a vibrant brass band repertoire, featuring solo performances from our principal cornetist.

event_items.title: Advent Concert
event_items.description: We ring in the Advent season with atmospheric music in the church. Take a break from the pre-Christmas rush and join us.

event_items.title: Christmas Concert
event_items.description: A traditional Christmas concert for the whole family. Well-known and beloved Christmas carols performed in grand brass arrangements.

event_items.title: New Year's Concert
event_items.description: Celebrate the new year with Viennese waltzes, marches, and sparkling music to warm up in the winter cold!

event_items.title: NM Brass 2027
event_items.description: Norwegian Championship for brass bands. Come and support us as we compete against the best bands in the country!

event_items.title: Innlandet Championship
event_items.description: Regional championship for youth and amateur brass bands in Innlandet. We are fine-tuning our performance to compete for a podium finish.

event_items.title: Spring Concert
event_items.description: Welcome to a light and playful spring concert featuring a varied program of film, pop, and musical theatre classics.

event_items.title: May 17th Parade Performance
event_items.description: True to tradition, we will perform in the Constitution Day parade and host a mini-concert at the senior center. Happy Constitution Day!

event_items.title: Summer Concert in the Park
event_items.description: An outdoor concert to celebrate the start of summer vacation. Bring a picnic blanket, family, and friends!

event_items.title: Autumn Festival & Seminar Showcase
event_items.description: The finale to our major autumn music workshop. We will showcase everything we practiced over the weekend. Coffee and cakes sold during the interval.

history.title: Our History & Purpose
history.content: Brøttum Brass was founded to bring together passionate brass musicians from the local community. Over the decades, the band has evolved from a local gathering into a competitive brass band delivering high-level concert experiences.

mission.title: Core Mission
mission.content: We aim to inspire musical enthusiasm, promote the brass band tradition in Innlandet, and provide our members with an inclusive environment for artistic growth.

conductors.name: Kari Nordmann
conductors.bio: Kari is an experienced conductor with a background in both classical and popular music. She has led Brøttum Brass since 2020 and has a passion for developing musical talent.
conductors.title: Chief Conductor
conductors.vision: To cultivate a vibrant and inclusive brass band community, fostering musical excellence and creativity among our members.

conductors.name: Lars Johansen
conductors.bio: Lars is a versatile conductor and arranger, known for his innovative programming and dynamic conducting style. He has been a guest conductor for Brøttum Brass on several occasions.
conductors.title: Guest Conductor
conductors.vision: To inspire and develop the next generation of brass musicians.

members.subtitle: Meet the talented musicians of Brøttum Brass. Our members are the heart and soul of our band, bringing passion and dedication to every performance.

member_items.name: Ola Nordmann
member_items.bio: Ola is a dedicated cornet player with a passion for classical and contemporary brass music. He has been a member of Brøttum Brass for over 10 years, contributing to numerous performances and competitions.

member_items.name: Kari Nordmann
member_items.bio: Kari is a talented percussion player known for her expressive playing style. She has been with Brøttum Brass for 5 years and has participated in various national and international competitions.

member_items.name: Per Hansen
member_items.bio: Per is a skilled trombone player with a background in jazz and classical music. He has been a member of Brøttum Brass for 8 years, bringing his expertise to the band's performances.
